operator: exact discrete quadratic tensor, independently checked on dense fields
frame: free co-moving increment,3 extra unknowns in both arms
common_ic: identical reconstruction of multistart head fit, same coefficients/frame at t0
native_ic: span Euclidean projection of identical original physical u0; separately labeled

solver.algorithm: adaptive diagonally-scaled LM with accepted/rejected trial history
solver.stagnation: rejected-trial or representable-step termination saved; never accepted as stationarity

qualification.tight_tighter_normalization: norm of original physical initial field

primary_criteria.head_benefit: paired common-IC head max-over-time physical error lower than span under numerically qualified common settings; report all cases, median, worst, outliers; do not require favorable outcome for acceptance
primary_criteria.mechanism: residual reduction and physical drift tracked separately; span distance to head image is multistart best-found in reached frame, not certified/global
primary_criteria.invariance: compare qualification and effect under rows292->584 and dt0.02->0.01

stopping_gates: any numerical failure must be diagnosed before expanding cases
head benefit loss retained, no selective case removal
after dev2 pass request internal release for dev16
diagnostics: coefficients,head codes,frame increments and accumulated centers
physical trial tangent normalized spectra including3frame variables
multistart fixed-frame distance from span to head
same-previous-state span solve seeded by reached head coefficients
outputs: summary.json, case_*/trajectory arrays, histories,source/config/hardware metadata; measured plots only

reference_refinement.scope: same grid discrete FOM, not continuum

time_refinement_scope: method-setting robustness: diffusion row weights also depend on dt; no temporal order claim
